chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Regarding a man who captured a runaway slave and then it escaped from him, he said: “There is nothing upon him.”

key_terms.آبِقًا: a runaway slave who has absconded
key_terms.رَجُلٍ: a man; the individual addressed in the legal case
key_terms.لَيْسَ عَلَيْهِ شَيْءٌ: there is no liability or obligation upon him
key_terms.مِنْهُ: from him; from the custody of that man

ai.seo_question: Is a person liable if a runaway slave escapes after being captured by him?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about a person who apprehends a runaway slave and then the slave escapes from him. The Imam عليه السلام states that no liability is imposed upon that person in this case.
